name: Bacon Street Dog with Peppers, Onions & Spicy Mayo
whyItWorks: Bacon-wrapped beef dog topped with sauteed bell peppers, onions, pickled jalapenos, and spicy chipotle crema. The intense combination of cured pork grease, raw capsicums, and alliums is a notorious Crohn's trigger.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Irritant Warning: Avoid street dogs. Stick to a simple plain hot dog on a white bun.
